purpose: A direct pending receiver takes the same array as argument/current; its finally mutates the raw row after the unused snapshot should have retired.
source:
<?php

class UnusedDirectSendRowLive42 { function __destruct() { echo "C-LIVE|"; } }
class UnusedDirectSendRowReturn42 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function &unusedDirectSendRowChild42() { global $row; $row = [new UnusedDirectSendRowOld42()]; echo "C|"; yield 7 => $row; echo "L|"; return [new UnusedDirectSendRowReturn42()]; }
function unusedDirectSendRowMiddle42() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; $GLOBALS["row"][0] = new UnusedDirectSendRowLive42(); echo "J-END|"; } }
function unusedDirectSendRowUpper42() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function unusedDirectSendRowOuter42() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function unusedDirectSendRowDrop42($chosen) { echo "TAKE|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "CLEARED|"; return $chosen; }
$child = unusedDirectSendRowChild42(); $middle = unusedDirectSendRowMiddle42(); $upper = unusedDirectSendRowUpper42(); $outer = unusedDirectSendRowOuter42();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|";
$middle->current(); echo "G|";
echo "S|";
$middle->send(unusedDirectSendRowDrop42($middle->current())); echo "CALLER|"; unset($row); echo "ROW-DROPPED|"; echo "E";

purpose: After equal object argument/current copies retire, finally clears the raw reference cell; observe its cache RuntimeException and whether J-END is reached.

<?php
class UnusedDirectSendObjectCache42 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw new RuntimeException("cache42"); } }
class UnusedDirectSendObjectReturn42 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function &unusedDirectSendObjectChild42() { global $slot; $slot = new UnusedDirectSendObjectCache42(); echo "C|"; yield $slot; echo "L|"; return [new UnusedDirectSendObjectReturn42()]; }
function unusedDirectSendObjectMiddle42() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; $GLOBALS["slot"] = null; echo "J-END|"; } }
function unusedDirectSendObjectUpper42() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function unusedDirectSendObjectOuter42() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function unusedDirectSendObjectDrop42($chosen) { echo "TAKE|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "CLEARED|"; return $chosen; }
$child = unusedDirectSendObjectChild42(); $middle = unusedDirectSendObjectMiddle42(); $upper = unusedDirectSendObjectUpper42(); $outer = unusedDirectSendObjectOuter42();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|";
$middle->current(); echo "G|";
echo "S|";
try { $middle->send(unusedDirectSendObjectDrop42($middle->current())); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Throwable $cleanup) { echo "CALLER|", $cleanup instanceof RuntimeException ? 1 : 0, "|", $cleanup->getMessage() === "cache42" ? 1 : 0, "|", $cleanup->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
